class WRehearsal:
    run: str
    root: Path  # outside every repository
    delay_s: float = 2.0  # not_before = seal time + delay
    log: Callable[[str], None] = print

    @property
    def repo(self) -> Path:
        return self.root / "repo"


def prepare(cfg: WRehearsal) -> None:
    if _inside_git_worktree(cfg.root / "x"):
        raise RehearsalError(f"{cfg.root} is inside a git worktree: rehearsals run outside")
    if cfg.repo.exists():
        raise RehearsalError(f"{cfg.repo} exists: every rehearsal starts fresh")
    origin = cfg.root / "origin.git"
    origin.mkdir(parents=True)
    _git(origin, "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main")
    cfg.repo.mkdir()
    _git(cfg.repo, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
    for key, value in {**IDENTITY, "core.autocrlf": "false"}.items():
        _git(cfg.repo, "config", key, value)
    files = {FETCH: HEALTHY, "hosts/practice/practice/__init__.py": "",
             "hosts/practice/tests/test_fetch.py": TESTS,
             ".kintsugi/holdout.sha256": "# practice: no holdout (disclosed)\n"}  # fmt: skip
    for relative, text in files.items():
        path = cfg.repo / relative
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    _commit(cfg.repo, "practice: the healthy practice host")
    _git(cfg.repo, "remote", "add", "origin", str(origin))
    _git(cfg.repo, "push", "-q", "origin", "main")


def run(cfg: WRehearsal) -> dict[str, Any]:
    started = time.monotonic()
    cfg.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cfg.log(f"[{cfg.run}] preparing the practice monorepo under {cfg.root}")
    prepare(cfg)
    keys = cfg.root / "keys"
    keys.mkdir()
    signer = attest.Ed25519Signer.generate()  # a rehearsal key, never the T0 key (A-4)
    signer.save(keys / "attest-rehearsal", keys / "attest-rehearsal.pub")
    secret, recipient = sealed.new_identity()
    (keys / "sabotage.agekey").write_text(secret + "\n", encoding="ascii")
    saboteur = Saboteur(cfg.root / "sabotage-store", (recipient,), (HOST,))
    not_before = datetime.now(UTC) + timedelta(seconds=cfg.delay_s)
    spec = compose(SPEC_ID, "code.regression.exception_swallow", host=HOST, framing=FRAMING,
                   patch=PATCH, not_before=not_before.isoformat(), seed=4242,
                   ground_truth={"files": [FETCH], "symbols": ["fetch_all"],
                                 "mechanism": "a broad except returns an empty list"})  # fmt: skip
    record = saboteur.seal(spec, PATCH)
    cfg.log(f"[{cfg.run}] sealed {SPEC_ID}: c = {record['c'][:23]}…")
    log_path = cfg.repo / "sabotage-log" / f"{SPEC_ID}.json"
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log_path.write_text(canonicalize(record).decode("utf-8") + "\n", encoding="utf-8",
                        newline="\n")  # fmt: skip
    (cfg.repo / ".kintsugi" / "attest.pub").write_text(signer.public_key_openssh() + "\n",
                                                       encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")  # fmt: skip
    _commit(cfg.repo, "practice: the rehearsal attestation key and the sealed commitment")
    _git(cfg.repo, "push", "-q", "origin", "main")
    from kintsugi.control.genesis import write_genesis

    made = write_genesis(cfg.repo, github_repo=f"local/{cfg.run}", rulesets=[0])
    t0_commit = _commit(cfg.repo, f"T0: the window record of practice run {cfg.run}")
    _git(cfg.repo, "push", "-q", "origin", "main", "refs/heads/ledger")
    cfg.log(
        f"[{cfg.run}] T0 {made.window.t0}: genesis {made.genesis[:12]}…, T0 commit {t0_commit[:12]}"
    )
    runtime_file = cfg.root / "runtime.json"
    settings = {"repo": str(cfg.repo), "t0_key": str(keys / "attest-rehearsal"),
                "crew_model": "offline", "state": str(cfg.root / "state")}  # fmt: skip
    runtime_file.write_text(json.dumps(settings), encoding="utf-8")
    crew = build(RuntimeConfig.load(runtime_file))
    notary = Notary(signer, run=OfflineNotarySession(), require_checkpoint=False)
    pulls = LocalPulls(cfg.repo)
    lane = UpstreamLane(cfg.repo, notary, pulls, UpstreamConfig(poll_s=0, ci_timeout_s=0))
    crew.sabotage = SabotageLane(saboteur, secret, deliver=lane.deliver)  # pre-T0 seal: no publish
    step: Any = None
    crew.do_seal_sabotage(step, SPEC_ID)
    time.sleep(max(0.0, (not_before - datetime.now(UTC)).total_seconds()) + 0.5)
    crew.do_deliver_sabotage(step, SPEC_ID)
    cfg.log(f"[{cfg.run}] delivered through {pulls.pulls[1]['url']} ({pulls.pulls[1]['head']})")
    tag = crew.do_anchor_ledger(step, 0)
    cfg.log(f"[{cfg.run}] anchored {tag} and pushed the ledger")
    _git(cfg.repo, "checkout", "-q", "main")
    _git(cfg.repo, "pull", "-q", "--ff-only", "origin", "main")
    window = json.loads((cfg.repo / audit.WINDOW_FILE).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    window["t1"] = datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
    (cfg.repo / audit.WINDOW_FILE).write_text(json.dumps(window, indent=2) + "\n",
                                              encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")  # fmt: skip
    _spec, seal, _patch = saboteur.open(SPEC_ID, secret)
    path, body = Saboteur.reveal(spec, seal)
    (cfg.repo / path).write_bytes(body)
    _commit(cfg.repo, f"After W: t1 and the reveal of {SPEC_ID}")
    _git(cfg.repo, "push", "-q", "origin", "main")
    report = audit.run_audit(cfg.repo, selection=audit.Selection(checks=CHECKS))
    results = {r.check: r.as_dict() for r in report.results}
    cfg.log(f"[{cfg.run}] audit {', '.join(f'{k} {v["status"]}' for k, v in results.items())}")
    return summarize(
        cfg,
        crew.ledger.entries(),
        results,
        report.exit_code,
        tag,
        duration_s=time.monotonic() - started,
    )


def summarize(
    cfg: WRehearsal,
    entries: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    results: Mapping[str, Any],
    exit_code: int,
    tag: str,
    *,
    duration_s: float,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Aggregate evidence: no key, no honeytoken, no patch."""
    return {
        "kind": "w-wiring-rehearsal", "run": cfg.run, "phase": "rehearsal", "model": "offline",
        "disclosed": ["practice host hosts/practice (not a fleet host)",
                      "practice spec S-P1 code.regression.exception_swallow (not S-17/18/19)",
                      "rehearsal attestation key (not the T0 key)",
                      "offline notary stand-in (git apply; no Entire checkpoint)",
                      "local pull requests (practice tests as CI; --no-ff merges)"],
        "ledger": [{"seq": e["seq"], "type": e.get("type"), "event": e.get("event")}
                   for e in entries],
        "anchor": tag, "audit": {"checks": list(CHECKS), "exit_code": exit_code,
                                 "results": dict(results)},
        "not_exercised": {"C2-C5": "Entire checkpoints from real sessions",
                          "C7,C12": "GitHub", "C8-C10": "neatlogs",
                          "C11,C14": "antibodies and self-repairs inside W",
                          "C13": "the practice host has no sealed holdout"},
        "duration_s": round(duration_s, 1),
    }  # fmt: skip


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="The W wiring rehearsal (offline, disclosed).")
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, required=True, help="scratch dir outside any repo")
    parser.add_argument("--run", default=datetime.now(UTC).strftime("w-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, help="write the aggregate summary here")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    summary = run(WRehearsal(args.run, args.root / args.run))
    text = json.dumps(summary, indent=1, sort_keys=True) + "\n"
    if args.out:
        args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        args.out.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(text)
    return 0 if summary["audit"]["exit_code"] == audit.EXIT_OK else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

input.content:
"""Write-back to neatlogs traces (spec §4.2): the culprit span and the repair's verdict.

- **Culprit** (after attribution): ``PUT /traces/{traceId}/spans/{spanId}/feedback`` with a
  ``down`` vote and the incident's diagnosis on the span the failure observation points at (the
  first failed tool span, else the grader's verdict span, as ``signature.from_trace`` picks it).
- **Verdict** (after the canary resolves the incident): ``POST /traces/{traceId}/feedback`` on
  each failing trace, rated +100 with the incident, the repair's PR and the error class as the
  issue type, so the trace history shows the failure was repaired and how.

Both operations need an OAuth user token (``NEATLOGS_OAUTH_TOKEN``, A-29). Feedback is
best-effort evidence, never a step's outcome: every call is idempotent (a key per trace, span
and incident), and a missing credential or an API error is recorded in the result instead of
failing the incident.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from collections.abc import Iterable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.senses.neatlogs_api import ApiError, CredentialUnavailable
from kintsugi.senses.records import VERDICT_SPAN, TraceRecord, load_trace

NOTE_LIMIT = 2000  # span notes hold at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes


def _key(*parts: str) -> str:
    return "kintsugi-feedback-" + hashlib.sha256("\x1f".join(parts).encode()).hexdigest()[:40]


def culprit_span(record: TraceRecord) -> Any:
    """The span a failure observation names: the first failed tool span, else the verdict."""
    spans = sorted(record.spans, key=lambda s: s.started_at)
    failing = next((s for s in spans if s.failed and s.kind == "TOOL"), None)
    if failing is None:
        failing = next((s for s in spans if s.name == VERDICT_SPAN), None)
    return failing


@dataclass
class TraceFeedback:
    api: Any  # kintsugi.senses.neatlogs_api.NeatlogsApi

    def _send(self, call: Any) -> str:
        try:
            call()
        except CredentialUnavailable as error:
            return f"skipped: {error}"[:300]
        except ApiError as error:
            return f"failed: {error}"[:300]
        return "sent"

    def culprit(self, incident: str, trace_ids: Iterable[str], diagnosis: str
                ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:  # fmt: skip
        results = []
        for trace_id in list(trace_ids)[:20]:
            try:
                span = culprit_span(load_trace(self.api, trace_id))
            except (CredentialUnavailable, ApiError) as error:
                results.append({"trace": trace_id, "status": f"failed: {error}"[:300]})
                continue
            if span is None:
                results.append({"trace": trace_id, "status": "skipped: no failing span"})
                continue
            note = f"{incident}: {diagnosis}"[:NOTE_LIMIT]
            status = self._send(lambda span_id=span.span_id: self.api.span_feedback(
                trace_id, span_id, "down", note=note,
                idempotency_key=_key(trace_id, span_id, incident)))  # fmt: skip
            results.append({"trace": trace_id, "span": span.span_id, "status": status})
        return results

    def verdict(self, incident: str, trace_ids: Iterable[str], *, pr_url: str | None,
                error_class: str | None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:  # fmt: skip
        comment = f"Repaired by KINTSUGI-Omega incident {incident}" + (
            f": {pr_url}" if pr_url else "")  # fmt: skip
        body: dict[str, Any] = {"rating": 100, "comment": comment}
        if error_class:
            body["issueTypes"] = [error_class[:100]]
        results = []
        for trace_id in list(trace_ids)[:20]:
            status = self._send(lambda trace_id=trace_id: self.api.trace_feedback(
                trace_id, body, idempotency_key=_key(trace_id, incident, "verdict")))  # fmt: skip
            results.append({"trace": trace_id, "status": status})
        return results

"""Write-back to neatlogs traces (§4.2): the culprit span after attribution, the verdict after
the canary; best-effort, idempotent, OAuth-only (A-29)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from typing import Any

import httpx

from kintsugi.senses.feedback import TraceFeedback, culprit_span
from kintsugi.senses.neatlogs_api import CredentialUnavailable
from kintsugi.senses.records import load_trace
from tests.senses.test_neatlogs_api import Recorder, make_api
from tests.senses.test_records_and_tags import FixtureApi

TRACE = "d23ffdad100e3a3bd55365ebc266447d"
KEY = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$")  # unpadded base64url SHA-256 (A-35)


class FeedbackApi(FixtureApi):
    """The recorded trace plus feedback calls recorded (or refused without OAuth)."""

    def __init__(self, *, oauth: bool = True) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.oauth = oauth
        self.sent: list[tuple[str, Any, ...]] = []

    def span_feedback(self, trace_id: str, span_id: str, vote: str, *, note: str | None = None,
                      idempotency_key: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:  # fmt: skip
        if not self.oauth:
            raise CredentialUnavailable("traces.span_feedback needs NEATLOGS_OAUTH_TOKEN")
        self.sent.append(("span", trace_id, span_id, vote, note, idempotency_key))
        return {}

    def trace_feedback(self, trace_id: str, body: dict[str, Any], *,
                       idempotency_key: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:  # fmt: skip
        if not self.oauth:
            raise CredentialUnavailable("traces.feedback needs NEATLOGS_OAUTH_TOKEN")
        self.sent.append(("trace", trace_id, body, idempotency_key))
        return {}


def test_the_culprit_is_the_span_the_failure_observation_names() -> None:
    record = load_trace(FixtureApi(), TRACE)
    span = culprit_span(record)
    assert span is not None
    assert span.name == "grader.verdict"  # a passing recorded trace: no failed tool span


def test_culprit_and_verdict_are_sent_once_per_trace_with_stable_keys() -> None:
    api = FeedbackApi()
    feedback = TraceFeedback(api)
    first = feedback.culprit("INC-0042", [TRACE], "state reset on retry in run_reconcile")
    again = feedback.culprit("INC-0042", [TRACE], "state reset on retry in run_reconcile")
    assert first == again
    assert first[0]["status"] == "sent"
    kind, trace, span, vote, note, key = api.sent[0]
    assert (kind, trace, vote) == ("span", TRACE, "down")
    assert note.startswith("INC-0042: state reset")
    assert KEY.match(key) and key == api.sent[1][5]  # noqa: PT018 - the same write, the same key
    verdict = feedback.verdict("INC-0042", [TRACE], pr_url="https://example.invalid/pr/5",
                               error_class="kintsugi:phi-ledger")  # fmt: skip
    assert verdict == [{"trace": TRACE, "status": "sent"}]
    _, _, body, vkey = api.sent[-1]
    assert body == {"rating": 100, "issueTypes": ["kintsugi:phi-ledger"],
                    "comment": "Repaired by KINTSUGI-Omega incident INC-0042: "
                               "https://example.invalid/pr/5"}  # fmt: skip
    assert KEY.match(vkey) and vkey != key  # noqa: PT018


def test_without_an_oauth_token_feedback_is_skipped_never_raised() -> None:
    feedback = TraceFeedback(FeedbackApi(oauth=False))
    [culprit] = feedback.culprit("INC-0042", [TRACE], "diagnosis")
    assert culprit["status"].startswith("skipped:")
    [verdict] = feedback.verdict("INC-0042", [TRACE], pr_url=None, error_class=None)
    assert verdict["status"].startswith("skipped:")


def test_the_client_puts_span_feedback_with_oauth_and_refuses_without() -> None:
    ok = httpx.Response(200, json={"data": {}, "success": True})
    recorder = Recorder(ok)
    api = make_api(recorder, oauth="oauth-token")
    api.span_feedback(TRACE, "1c1bd14702021f71", "down", note="INC-0042: culprit",
                      idempotency_key="a" * 43)  # fmt: skip
    [request] = recorder.requests
    assert request.method == "PUT"
    assert request.url.path.endswith(f"/traces/{TRACE}/spans/1c1bd14702021f71/feedback")
    assert request.headers["authorization"] == "Bearer oauth-token"
    assert request.headers["idempotency-key"] == "a" * 43
    assert json.loads(request.content) == {"vote": "down", "note": "INC-0042: culprit"}
    without = make_api(Recorder(), oauth=None)
    feedback = TraceFeedback(without)
    assert feedback.verdict("INC-0042", [TRACE], pr_url=None, error_class=None)[0][
        "status"].startswith("skipped:")  # fmt: skip
